properties.notes: The site is located adjacent to Swanley urban confines. The existing access onto Swanley Lane could be utilised. Overall the southern portion of the site containing permanent buildings is considered able to accommodate development however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
